# Redis Compilation Instructions

## Prerequisites
- C compiler (GCC or Clang)
- Make
- For TLS support: OpenSSL development libraries
- For 32-bit builds: `gcc-multilib` and `g++-multilib` (Debian/Ubuntu)

## Basic Build
```sh
make
```

## Build Options

### TLS Support
```sh
make BUILD_TLS=yes
```

### Allocator Selection
Redis uses jemalloc by default. To use the system allocator:
```sh
make MALLOC=libc
```

### Compiler Selection
```sh
make CC=gcc
make CC=clang
make CXX=g++
make CXX=clang++
```

### Sanitizers
```sh
make SANITIZER=address
make SANITIZER=undefined
```

### Optimization and Debug Flags
```sh
make OPTIMIZATION=-O2
make DEBUG=-g
make WARN=-Wall -Wextra
```

### Custom Flags
```sh
make CFLAGS=-I/path/to/include
make LDFLAGS=-L/path/to/lib
make CPPFLAGS=-DDEBUG
```

### Verbose Build
```sh
make V=1
```

## 32-bit Build
```sh
sudo apt-get install gcc-multilib g++-multilib
make CFLAGS="-m32" LDFLAGS="-m32"
```

## Troubleshooting
If you encounter build issues due to cached options or dependencies:
```sh
make distclean
make
```

## Running with TLS
```sh
./src/redis-server --tls-port 6380 --port 0 \
  --tls-cert-file /path/to/cert.pem \
  --tls-key-file /path/to/key.pem \
  --tls-ca-cert-file /path/to/ca.pem
```

# Redis Compilation Instructions

## Prerequisites
- C compiler (GCC or Clang)
- Make
- For TLS support: OpenSSL development libraries
- For 32-bit builds: `gcc-multilib` and `g++-multilib` (Debian/Ubuntu)

## Basic Build
```sh
make
```

## Build Options

### TLS Support
```sh
make BUILD_TLS=yes
```

### Allocator Selection
Redis uses jemalloc by default. To use the system allocator:
```sh
make MALLOC=libc
```

### Compiler Selection
```sh
make CC=gcc
make CC=clang
make CXX=g++
make CXX=clang++
```

### Sanitizers
```sh
make SANITIZER=address
make SANITIZER=undefined
```

### Optimization and Debug Flags
```sh
make OPTIMIZATION=-O2
make DEBUG=-g
make WARN=-Wall -Wextra
```

### Custom Flags
```sh
make CFLAGS=-I/path/to/include
make LDFLAGS=-L/path/to/lib
make CPPFLAGS=-DDEBUG
```

### Verbose Build
```sh
make V=1
```

## 32-bit Build
```sh
sudo apt-get install gcc-multilib g++-multilib
make CFLAGS="-m32" LDFLAGS="-m32"
```

## Troubleshooting
